description: Decoded contract events from recent blocks: give a contract address and an event signature ("Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)"), optionally filter on any indexed argument by name, and get the matching logs from the last N blocks decoded to named fields with block, transaction and log index. No ABI file, no RPC key. Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon; up to 5,000 blocks and 200 events per call. $0.004. Costs $0.004 USDC per call (x402).

blocks.description: how many recent blocks to scan, default 200, max 5000

from.description: optional filter on the indexed argument named from

to.description: optional filter on the indexed argument named to

name: evm_events
title: evm events
